equation_summary: Lightning indexer scores every causal key: I[t,s] = sum_j w_idx[t,j] * act(scale * q_idx[t,j] . k_idx[s]) (MQA-style shared index key; optional monotone activation such as relu; weights per head). Top-k causal keys per query are kept, invisible slots padded -1, selection shared across all query heads. Main attention is then softmax(scale q.k) v over the gathered selected tokens only.
state_shape: external KV cache; indexer projections (q_idx/k_idx/w_idx) external
gate_scope: data-dependent per-token top-k selection via indexer
